title: Exec briefing: decision canvas and risk commitment ledger for quarterly roadmap
creator: Marisol Kim
description:
Purpose: Produce an exec-facing briefing packet that surfaces a decision canvas for prioritized initiatives and a risk commitment ledger that ties each risk to mitigations, owners, and resource asks. The pack should enable the executive committee to:
- Choose which initiatives to accelerate, hold, or defer given current capacity and runway metrics.
- Understand residual risks and the concrete commitments required (budget, headcount, fallbacks).
- Approve a concise set of gating decisions and escalation lanes for the next 90 days.

Scope:
- Narrative slides: 10-12 slide packet (1 pager TL;DR, decision canvas, risk ledger, initiative health, SLO/cost metrics, asks).
- Appendices: KPI dashboards, short evaluation snapshots (quality regressions), rollout gating checklist, linked artifacts.
- Audience: CEO, CTO, Head of Ops, VP Product, Head of Research; shared 48 hrs prior to exec sync.

Key content elements:
1) Decision canvas: visually maps each initiative on two axes (strategic impact vs. operational risk), with proposed decision (accelerate/maintain/defer), confidence band, and mandatory gating criteria.
2) Risk commitment ledger: table of (Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Proposed Mitigation | Committed Owner | Resource Ask | Fallback). Ledger entries must include estimated cost or FTE as a number.
3) Initiative health snapshots: trendlines for throughput, latency p50/p95, cost/token, infra utilization, on-call incident cadence.
4) Scenario asks: best/worst/most-likely lanes with explicit asks for each scenario (budget delta, dedicated capacity, temporary pause).
5) Decision timeline and roll-forward lanes: when decisions must be made and who will enact approved changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exec packet delivered to stakeholders 48 hours before sync (deadline: 2026-03-18).
- All ledger items annotated with owner and quantitative ask.
- At least two mitigations for each high-impact risk.
- Dashboards linked and accessible (Grafana, Datadog, cost dashboards).

Deliverables:
- slides deck (PDF + Google Slides link), one-page TL;DR, live dashboard links, GitHub PR for any roadmap changes, action tracker.

Stakeholders and reviewers:
- Primary: Omar Singh (assignee, product lead), Marisol Kim (creator, PM sponsor), Priya Rao (Head of Research), Dante Miller (Infra), Lucia Park (Finance).

Communication plan:
- Draft in shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/rd/q2-exec-pack/PM-631045
- Confluence notes and decision log: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Exec+Decision+Canvas+2026-Q1
- Deck PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap-packs/pulls/172
- Readout meeting: 2026-03-19 10:00 PT (invite sent to execs).
